projects.name: runtoolkit/suite (monorepo)
projects.reason: The runtoolkit organization was retired in favor of vortacraftmc; the monorepo was archived (read-only) and its content continues in vortacraftmc/core.
known_issues: The per-project repos that were merged into it are private.

projects.name: DailyBonus
projects.reason: Archived by the maintainer; kept as a frozen, reference-only project. Moved out of packs/ so it is no longer zipped or merged; loading requires explicit operator approval.
known_issues: Load/tick hooks are gated: the pack stays inactive until an operator runs /function vcm_archive_dailybonus:confirm (see ARCHIVED.md). Functions called directly by other packs or players are not blocked.
Targets pack format 122.1 and is not maintained against newer Minecraft versions.
